title: Nourishing Velvety Brazilian Chicken Stew
description: A savory and nostalgic Brazilian dish featuring chicken and ketchup in a rich velvety sauce, cooked to perfection in a wok over a bain-marie.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the wok over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the wok and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the ketchup, salt, and black pepper to the wok, stirring to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, over a bain-marie for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
